title: The Donkey and the Lion
summary: Finding a discarded lion skin in the forest, Nasruddin's donkey wore it to scare the village sheep....
full_text:
Finding a discarded lion skin in the forest, Nasruddin's donkey wore it to scare the village sheep.

When the donkey attempted to roar like a lion, an enormous, unmistakable "Hee-haw!" burst from its throat.

The village dogs surrounded it and bit its heels. Nasruddin pulled off the pelt: "A borrowed lion skin cannot disguise the natural bray of an honest donkey!"
moral: Do not roar when you have the teeth of a donkey.
